The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI agents to interact with external tools and APIs. The official MCP Registry serves as a centralized repository for publicly accessible MCP servers, facilitating the discovery and integration of these servers by AI clients. ([modelcontextprotocol.info](https://modelcontextprotocol.info/tools/registry/?utm_source=openai))

Regarding the Synapse Network AI's MCP server, it is designed to allow AI assistants to query Synapse directly, enabling functionalities such as dataset searches, entity metadata inspection, project hierarchy exploration, and provenance tracing. This server is implemented in Python and built upon the `synapseclient` package, mirroring the capabilities available through the Synapse Python client. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))
